subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` default, or should this remain optional operator guidance after the wording is corrected?
rationale: The fixed env value changes a public deployment default and creates an operator keep-in-sync requirement that automation cannot choose as product policy.

options.title: Correct wording and keep the default only with proof
options.body: Reword the docs/comment around container headroom, require redacted Kubernetes proof, and ship the manifest default only if maintainers accept the operator tradeoff.

options.title: Make it optional guidance only
options.body: Keep the Kubernetes docs advice but remove the shared manifest default so operators opt in when their workload proves it needs a heap cap.

options.title: Pause or close the PR
options.body: If maintainers do not want Kubernetes heap-cap guidance in core manifests yet, leave this work out until a better deployment policy is defined.

recommendation.title: Correct wording and keep the default only with proof
recommendation.body: Reword the docs/comment around container headroom, require redacted Kubernetes proof, and ship the manifest default only if maintainers accept the operator tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom introduced the Kubernetes install surface and is the clearest history-backed routing candidate for this manifest/docs decision.
